name: @fitcut/admin
description: 관리자 API와 일별 집계 (Athena로 사용 이벤트, Cost Explorer로 비용, docs/ADMIN.md)

scripts.build: esbuild src/aggregate.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --minify --sourcemap --outfile=dist/aggregate/index.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" && esbuild src/api.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --minify --sourcemap --outfile=dist/api/index.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.cost:report: esbuild src/costReport.cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --log-level=warning --outfile=dist/cost-report.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" && node dist/cost-report.mjs
